cases.request: Document the module boundary and three acceptance checks for the greeting utility in ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptanceCriteria: ARCHITECTURE.md names the public function, input, output, and three checks

cases.request: Design a backwards-compatible pagination migration and record invariants, rollout, rollback, and verification in ARCHITECTURE.md without changing openapi.yaml.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan includes compatibility, rollout, rollback, observability, and invariants

cases.request: Produce a failure-safe data retention architecture covering authorization, deletion auditability, restore boundaries, and operator approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Architecture identifies destructive boundaries and mandatory human approvals

cases.request: Write a threat-model-driven architecture for rotating authentication credentials without downtime, including frozen invariants and incident recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan contains threats, mitigations, invariants, staged rollout, and recovery evidence

cases.request: Make the button accessible with a stable label and visible keyboard focus while preserving its click behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Button has an accessible name and focus-visible styling

cases.request: Implement explicit loading, empty, error, and populated render states in src/view.js with accessible status messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: All four states render deterministically and status text is announced

cases.request: Build a responsive dashboard shell that does not clip timestamps or workspace names at 320px and retains semantic navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: 320px layout wraps without horizontal clipping and navigation remains semantic

cases.request: Implement a destructive account-deletion confirmation UI requiring an exact typed phrase, clear irreversible-impact copy, and no implicit submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Deletion cannot submit without exact confirmation and the warning is accessible

cases.request: Validate that normalizeName rejects blank values and trims valid names without changing its export.
acceptanceCriteria: Blank input throws and valid input is trimmed

cases.request: Make applyCommand idempotent by command ID while preserving deterministic state transitions and add tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate command IDs do not apply state twice and tests prove it

cases.request: Implement a bounded async queue that preserves FIFO order, rejects invalid capacity, and never exceeds configured concurrency; add deterministic tests.
acceptanceCriteria: FIFO, capacity validation, and concurrency bounds are tested

cases.request: Implement deny-by-default project authorization without changing policy.json, including owner, member, and anonymous tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown roles and missing identity are denied; owner/member rules are covered

cases.request: Reproduce and fix the off-by-one bug in lastIndex and add a regression test.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression test fails on the old implementation and lastIndex returns length minus one

cases.request: Reproduce the timeout cleanup leak, fix it, and add a deterministic fake-timer-free regression test.
acceptanceCriteria: Cleanup is idempotent and no timer remains after cancellation

cases.request: Fix the parser so malformed and deeply nested input fails predictably without changing valid output; add boundary and regression tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid, malformed, empty, and depth-limit behavior is deterministic

cases.request: Fix interrupted journal recovery so committed entries survive, partial entries are ignored, and replay remains idempotent; add corruption tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Recovery handles committed, partial, duplicate, and corrupt entries without data loss

cases.request: Review src/math.js for correctness and maintainability and write evidence-linked findings to REVIEW.md without modifying source.
acceptanceCriteria: Every finding cites a file location or states that no issue was found

cases.request: Perform an evidence-only security review of the request handler and record severity, exploit condition, and remediation in REVIEW.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Findings distinguish evidence from uncertainty and include severity

cases.request: Review queue, retry, and shutdown behavior across the three modules and produce prioritized cross-module findings with reproducible evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Review covers ordering, duplicate work, backoff, and shutdown loss

cases.request: Independently review authentication and authorization boundaries for fail-open behavior, confused deputy risk, token leakage, and missing tests; do not modify code.
acceptanceCriteria: Review has evidence, severity, affected boundary, and blocking recommendation

cases.request: Create DELIVERY.md with setup, one verification command, expected result, and known limitation grounded only in repository evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: A new developer can reproduce the verification

cases.request: Write a quantified impact brief that clearly separates measured repository evidence, assumptions, and future targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Measured facts, assumptions, and targets are labeled separately

cases.request: Produce an evaluator-ready UI evidence manifest mapping every acceptance criterion to a screenshot placeholder, route, viewport, and reproducible capture step without claiming uncaptured evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest has criterion, route, viewport, capture step, and honest missing-evidence state

cases.request: Create a release evidence dossier linking security-sensitive requirements to immutable Git, verifier, reviewer, rollback, and operator-approval evidence without exposing secrets.
acceptanceCriteria: Every security requirement has reproducible evidence and an explicit approval owner

seedFiles.SECURITY_REQUIREMENTS.md:
- Authentication must deny unknown identities.
- Secrets must never be logged.
